task_name: On calcareers.ca.gov, browse full-time job postings in the Legal occupational category located in San Diego County with a minimum salary of at least $4,000 per month.

source.original_task_name: Find full-time legal occupation jobs in San Diego County with a minimum salary of $4,000+ per month.
source.intent_modified_reason: Added the site name. "Find" became browsing with the three filters, so the end state is the search results page rather than one posting. A .gov site has no regional redirects and no inventory-dependent results.
